html:
Perks › Epic

Runaway Train

Epic perk · Scoring bonus

Every third consecutive play made without drawing adds 15 points if it is a scoring play.

In-game card text

How it works

Every third play in a row without drawing (your 3rd, 6th, 9th and so on) gains +15 points for each copy if it scores.

  • The count includes plays that didn't score. Drawing, a Table Pass, passing on an empty boneyard and a new hand all reset it.

At a glance

RarityEpic
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 900 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Rare perks.
